published_baseline: Founder-approved Geomacro Commercial V1 website redesign with a concise signal-to-decision buyer journey across desktop and mobile; live Intelligence, separate Risk Indices, Critical Minerals and Rare Earth Risk, Ask Geomacro, institutional workflows, governed API and agent access, and Risk Gate boundaries remain clearly separated from technical-proof surfaces. Homepage remains pricing-free; Free Explorer and the 0.05 USDC x402 first-20,000 successful paid-delivery offer are presented under API and Agents. Customer Care and contact@geomacro.live remain the human support escalation path. Operational resilience update: the root error boundary self-heals stale hashed client assets after a publish and the visible retry performs a full document reload. Runtime website hardening update: x402 health probing is bounded; public Intelligence, Event detail, Risk Indices and Ask Geomacro use the verified B2 production serving boundary instead of customer-facing Supabase reads; interactive public server-function waits are bounded so stalled transport cannot leave a page in indefinite loading; Intelligence and event route preload failures render fail-closed page states instead of collapsing the route; the Intelligence Risk Indices panel shows an explicit unavailable state rather than an infinite skeleton. Production monitoring now validates rendered content markers and rejects the root error page across core, trust, commercial and technical-proof routes instead of accepting HTTP 200 alone. Production public identity remains buyer-first: Testnet API is isolated under Technical Proof, Arc/onchain retains the wallet execution context needed for that technical proof, and live commerce status distinguishes controlled pre-launch, controlled testnet and authorized production without representing testnet settlement as commercial revenue.
policy: Public website presentation is frozen. Intentional website changes require explicit founder approval and a dedicated baseline update.
